known_gap_assessment: Historical 790-second and epoch-boundary 199-second gaps exceed the 120-second acceptance limit and remain unexplained/unknown. Epoch-26 natural substantive points from 04:00:40 through 04:01:29 have gaps 14s, 17s, and 18s, but this is not a complete 900-second window and MUST NOT be promoted.
note: Commit timestamps are exact GitHub commit metadata. Scheduler mutation, heartbeat-only commits, and state bookkeeping are excluded as substantive evidence by themselves. Candidate points are not automatically SUBSTANTIVE_ACCEPTED; a completed-window auditor must classify them under the promotion policy.
